resources.string: Its users can only open and work in a property from inside the property\'s geofence. Properties without a geofence aren\'t affected.
Admins are never geo restricted, so someone can always fix a property\'s geofence.
Doesn\'t apply: users who can manage properties or access open every property from anywhere.
You\'re outside this property\'s geofence, so it\'s open to view only. Your group makes changes only from inside it.
